2.applies_to: user-scores.json schema_version 2 (v0.6.7 and v0.6.8): levels written with level 3 = the anchor claude-opus-5-5

source.statement: anchor.targets.<category>.facets.<facet>.levels 1..3 `target` of references/five-axis-scores.json as shipped in the v0.6.8 release (commit ce1fd40, schema agent-compass.five-axis-scores/5). The maintainer entries of references/user-scores.json were written on 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 against the same triads (commit 92d0501, five-axis-scores.json of 2026-11-11, schema /2; the creative facet was then named divergence.creative_writing).
source.note: On tool_operation.responsiveness the anchor sat at the panel median, so t3 equals t2 and every level between 2 and 3 meant the median.
